title: BetterFront UAT Scenario
description: Declarative JSON schema for authoring and validating BetterFront User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scenarios and customizable workflows.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON schema for IDE autocompletion and hover documentation.

name.title: Scenario Name
name.description: Descriptive human-readable title of this UAT flow (e.g. 'Dreamblu Fantasy - Core Topbar & HUD Navigation Flow').
examples: Dreamblu Fantasy - Core Homepage & Topbar UAT Flow

description.title: Scenario Description
description.description: Detailed explanation of what this scenario validates and what business outcomes are verified.

tags.title: Workflow Tags
tags.description: Categorization tags for filtering and organizing UAT scenarios.

startUrl.title: Starting URL
startUrl.description: Initial target URL navigated to at the beginning of the scenario. Supports {{BASE_URL}} interpolation.

baseUrl.title: Base URL (Optional)
baseUrl.description: Base origin used to resolve relative paths in GOTO steps (e.g. '/topbar' resolves to 'http://localhost:7777/topbar'). Defaults to startUrl.

variables.title: Customizable Workflow Variables
variables.description: Key-value map of customizable variables interpolated via {{KEY}} across URLs, selectors, and text fields. Can be overridden via CLI --var KEY=VALUE.

viewports.title: Target Viewports
viewports.description: List of viewport presets to execute this scenario against. If omitted, defaults to 'mobile_standard'.

anomalyChecks.title: Anomaly Quality Gates
anomalyChecks.description: Toggles for automated visual and runtime layout defect detection during scenario execution.

textOverlap.description: Detect mathematical and visual text-on-text collisions.

horizontalBleed.description: Detect mobile horizontal viewport overflow and sideways wobbling.

containerClipping.description: Detect content clipped by overflow:hidden containers without scroll.

interactiveOcclusion.description: Detect interactive elements (buttons, inputs) blocked by sticky headers or floating overlays.

unsizedMedia.description: Detect images/videos lacking width/height or aspect-ratio.

lowContrast.description: Verify WCAG 2.1 AA text contrast compliance.

touchTargetSize.description: Verify clickable buttons and links meet the 44x44px mobile touch requirement.

consoleExceptions.description: Detect unhandled JavaScript runtime exceptions and console errors.

brokenLinks.description: Detect broken links or dead anchor tags.

recording.title: Forensic & Motion Recording Options
recording.description: Configuration for video recording, Playwright trace archives, and automatic failure snapshots.

video.title: Record Full-Motion Video
video.description: Records full-motion .webm video of the scenario execution saved to artifacts directory.

trace.title: Record Playwright Trace
trace.description: Records interactive Playwright trace .zip archive with DOM snapshots, network waterfall, and timeline scrubbers.

screenshotOnFailure.title: Automatic Failure Capture
screenshotOnFailure.description: Automatically captures high-res screenshot with element highlight at the exact moment any step fails.

artifactsDir.title: Artifacts Directory
artifactsDir.description: Target folder for videos, traces, and screenshots. Defaults to './betterfront-artifacts'.

beforeSteps.title: Setup / Before Hook Steps
beforeSteps.description: Optional setup steps executed before the main scenario steps.

steps.title: UAT Steps
steps.description: Ordered sequence of declarative actions, user interactions, and assertions.

afterSteps.title: Teardown / After Hook Steps
afterSteps.description: Optional teardown or invariant assertion steps executed after the main scenario steps.

action.title: Step Action
action.description: The command or assertion to execute in this step.

description.title: Step Description
description.description: Human-readable label printed in the console and test report.

selector.title: Element Selector
selector.description: CSS selector targeting the element (supports {{VARIABLE}} interpolation).

fallbackSelectors.title: Resilient Fallback Selectors
fallbackSelectors.description: Ordered list of fallback CSS selectors tried if the primary selector is not present.

url.title: Target URL
url.description: URL or relative path for GOTO, WAIT_FOR_NAV, or ASSERT_URL.

urlPattern.title: Network URL Filter Pattern
urlPattern.description: Optional URL substring filter for ASSERT_NETWORK_OK.

text.title: Text Value
text.description: Text to type (for TYPE), match (for ASSERT_TEXT), or document title (for ASSERT_TITLE).

value.title: Option, Attribute, CSS, or Storage Value
value.description: Expected or assigned value for SELECT, ASSERT_VALUE, ASSERT_ATTRIBUTE, ASSERT_CSS, SET_STORAGE, or ASSERT_STORAGE.

key.title: Keyboard Key or Storage Key
key.description: Keyboard key to press for PRESS_KEY (e.g. 'Enter', 'Escape', 'Tab', 'Shift+Tab') or storage item key for SET_STORAGE / ASSERT_STORAGE.

attribute.title: HTML Attribute Name
attribute.description: HTML attribute name to check for ASSERT_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'aria-expanded', 'href', 'disabled').

property.title: CSS Property Name
property.description: Computed CSS property name to check for ASSERT_CSS (e.g. 'display', 'position', 'opacity').

storageType.title: Web Storage Type
storageType.description: Target Web Storage for SET_STORAGE or ASSERT_STORAGE.

state.title: Element State
state.description: Target DOM state for WAIT_FOR action.

count.title: Element Count
count.description: Expected number of matched elements for ASSERT_COUNT.

exact.title: Exact Match
exact.description: If true, performs strict string equality instead of substring inclusion.

clearFirst.title: Clear Input Before Typing
clearFirst.description: For TYPE action: if true, clears the input before typing. Defaults to true.

pressEnter.title: Press Enter After Typing
pressEnter.description: For TYPE action: if true, presses the Enter key immediately after typing.

delayMs.title: Typing Delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Milliseconds delay between keystrokes for TYPE action.

scrollPx.title: Scroll Distance (px)
scrollPx.description: Pixel distance to scroll (positive for down, negative for up). Defaults to 500.

direction.title: Scroll Direction
direction.description: Direction to scroll for SCROLL action.

waitMs.title: Wait Duration (ms)
waitMs.description: Duration in milliseconds to pause for WAIT action. Defaults to 1000.

timeoutMs.title: Step Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Custom maximum timeout in milliseconds for this step.

minPx.title: Minimum Touch Target Size (px)
minPx.description: For ASSERT_TOUCH_TARGET: minimum required width and height in pixels (defaults to 44px).

minRatio.title: Minimum Contrast Ratio
minRatio.description: For ASSERT_CONTRAST: minimum required contrast ratio (defaults to 4.5).

width.title: Viewport Width (px)
width.description: For SET_VIEWPORT: new viewport width in pixels.

height.title: Viewport Height (px)
height.description: For SET_VIEWPORT: new viewport height in pixels.

isMobile.title: Mobile Viewport Flag
isMobile.description: For SET_VIEWPORT: whether the new viewport should be treated as mobile.

profile.title: Form Filler Profile
profile.description: Semantic data generator profile for FILL_FORM action.

name.title: Screenshot / Breakpoint Name
name.description: Custom file prefix for SCREENSHOT action or label for SET_VIEWPORT.

fullPage.title: Full Page Screenshot
fullPage.description: For SCREENSHOT action: if true, captures the entire scrollable document height.

script.title: Custom Script
script.description: JavaScript expression or function body to evaluate in the browser page for EXECUTE_SCRIPT.

optional.title: Optional Step
optional.description: If true, failure of this step logs a warning and does not abort the scenario.

ifVisible.title: Conditional Visibility Guard
ifVisible.description: If true (or a selector string), executes this step only if the element is currently visible; otherwise cleanly skips.

onlyOnViewport.title: Only Run On Viewports
onlyOnViewport.description: Run this step only on matching viewports (e.g. ['mobile_standard', 'mobile']).

skipOnViewport.title: Skip On Viewports
skipOnViewport.description: Skip this step on matching viewports (e.g. ['desktop_fhd']).

retries.title: Step Retries
retries.description: Number of automatic retry attempts if the step fails.

retryDelayMs.title: Retry Delay (ms)
retryDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between retry attempts.
